rows.label: Tax status: French collectivity with its own tax powers
rows.value: New Caledonia, a French collectivity under articles 76 and 77 of the Constitution, has its own tax powers (organic law 99-209 of 19 March 1999, art. 22): its taxes are set by the Congress of New Caledonia and administered by the Direction des Services Fiscaux, not by the French DGFiP, and a tax treaty with France avoids double taxation. Social insurance is run by the CAFAT. Amounts are in CFP francs (XPF).
